note: 场景事件全部写在这里；何时出由导演 content/pacing.json 决定；字段说明见 content/README_events.md。

intro.en: 💥 Yesterday's monster crashed into the wall and left a hole {w} m wide and {h} m tall! Something is peeking through…
intro.zh: 💥 昨天的怪兽撞墙逃走，墙上留下一个宽 {w} 米、高 {h} 米的洞！洞里好像有眼睛在看…

q.en: The hole is {w} m by {h} m. What is its area in m²?
q.zh: 洞宽 {w} 米、高 {h} 米，面积是多少平方米？

q.en: The builder charges {c} coins per m². How much to fix the wall?
q.zh: 工人每平方米收 {c} 金币，修好要多少金币？

text.en: 🧱 The builder fixes the wall. You pay {cost} coins.
text.zh: 🧱 墙修好了，付了 {cost} 金币。

text.en: The builder is confused and will come back later. The hole scares 1 customer away each day for 2 days.
text.zh: 工人算不清，过两天再来。这两天墙上有洞，每天少来 1 位顾客。

intro.en: 👾 A big monster marches in with little monsters in {r} rows of {c}!
intro.zh: 👾 一只大怪兽带着一群小怪兽冲进来了，小怪排成 {r} 排，每排 {c} 只！

q.en: How many little monsters are there?
q.zh: 一共有多少只小怪兽？

q.en: Each little monster has {hp} hearts. How many hearts altogether?
q.zh: 每只小怪兽有 {hp} 颗心，一共多少颗心？

q.en: The big monster has {bhp} hearts. Your cream cannon takes {dmg} hearts per shot. How many shots?
q.zh: 大怪兽有 {bhp} 颗心，奶油炮每发打掉 {dmg} 颗，要打几发？

text.en: 🎉 The whole gang runs away! They drop {n} coins.
text.zh: 🎉 一群怪兽全被打跑了！掉下 {n} 金币。

text.en: They grab {r} strawberries and run!
text.zh: 它们抢走 {r} 颗草莓跑了！

intro.en: 🌀 The oven clock spins backwards… WHOOSH! A wormhole pulls the shop into {place}! An alien wants cupcakes.
intro.zh: 🌀 烤箱上的钟倒着转… 呼！一个虫洞把小店吸到了{place}！外星人想买蛋糕。

q.en: The alien buys {n} cupcakes at {p} {money} each. How many {money}?
q.zh: 外星人买 {n} 个蛋糕，每个 {p} {money}，一共多少{money}？

q.en: {rate} {money} = 1 coin. How many coins is that?
q.zh: {rate} {money} 换 1 金币，能换多少金币？

text.en: The wormhole spits you back home with {gold} coins and a bag of stardust sugar!
text.zh: 虫洞把你送回家，带回 {gold} 金币和一袋星尘糖！

text.en: The alien pays, but you lose some in the wormhole. Back home with 1 coin.
text.zh: 外星人付了钱，可在虫洞里掉了不少，回家只剩 1 金币。

intro.en: 🔥 The hot oven from yesterday cracks open time itself… you land in {place}!
intro.zh: 🔥 昨天过热的烤箱把时空烤裂了… 你掉进了{place}！

q.en: {d} baby dinosaurs each want {e} cupcakes. How many cupcakes?
q.zh: {d} 只小恐龙，每只要 {e} 个蛋糕，一共多少个？

q.en: Mummy dino gives you {egg} eggs for each baby. How many eggs?
q.zh: 恐龙妈妈为每只小恐龙送你 {egg} 个蛋，一共几个蛋？

text.en: A time-wind blows you home with a dinosaur egg!
text.zh: 一阵时空风把你吹回家，还带回一个恐龙蛋！

text.en: The dinosaurs eat everything and you float home empty-handed.
text.zh: 小恐龙把蛋糕吃光了，你两手空空飘回家。

intro.en: 🎟️ A mysterious fox paid with a portal coupon. It opens… you are in {place}! A delivery is waiting.
intro.zh: 🎟️ 一只神秘狐狸用传送券付了账，券一打开… 你到了{place}！有一单要送。

q.en: On the map 1 cm = {s} km. The cottage is {d} cm away. How many km?
q.zh: 地图上 1 厘米代表 {s} 千米，小屋在 {d} 厘米外，实际多少千米？

text.en: Delivered! The fox gives you another portal coupon.
text.zh: 送到了！狐狸又给你一张传送券。

text.en: You get lost, but the portal brings you back.
text.zh: 你迷路了，好在传送门把你送了回来。

intro.en: 🥶 An ice monster breathed on the shop! The fridge shows {t0} °C.
intro.zh: 🥶 冰怪对着小店吹了一口气！冰箱显示 {t0} °C。

q.en: Strawberries thaw at 4 °C. How many degrees must it warm up from {t0} °C?
q.zh: 草莓要到 4 °C 才解冻，从 {t0} °C 要升高多少度？

text.en: Thawed in time! You find an ice gem in the fridge.
text.zh: 及时解冻！还在冰箱里发现一颗冰晶。

text.en: 3 strawberries are ruined by the frost.
text.zh: 3 颗草莓被冻坏了。

intro.en: 🌪️ A tornado lifts the whole shop up to {place}! Cloud birds are hungry.
intro.zh: 🌪️ 一阵龙卷风把整个小店卷上了{place}！云雀们饿了。

q.en: {n} cloud birds each buy {k} cupcakes. How many cupcakes?
q.zh: {n} 只云雀，每只买 {k} 个蛋糕，一共几个？

q.en: The shop is {h} m up and floats down {d} m each minute. How many minutes to land?
q.zh: 小店在 {h} 米高，每分钟降 {d} 米，几分钟落地？

text.en: Soft landing! The birds paid {n} coins and left cloud candy.
text.zh: 平稳落地！云雀付了 {n} 金币，还留下云朵糖。

text.en: Bumpy landing — {k} strawberries fell out.
text.zh: 落地有点颠，掉了 {k} 颗草莓。

intro.en: 🎩 A travelling magician taps your tray with a wand: "Abracadabra!"
intro.zh: 🎩 一位流浪魔术师用魔杖点了点你的托盘：“变变变！”

q.en: You had {a} cupcakes. The magic makes {b} times as many. How many now?
q.zh: 原来有 {a} 个蛋糕，魔法让它变成 {b} 倍，现在几个？

q.en: The magician takes {c} as payment. How many are left?
q.zh: 魔术师拿走 {c} 个当酬劳，还剩几个？

text.en: ✨ You sell the magic cupcakes for {left} coins! The magician leaves his hat.
text.zh: ✨ 魔法蛋糕卖了 {left} 金币！魔术师把帽子留给了你。

text.en: Poof! The magic wears off.
text.zh: 噗！魔法失效了。

intro.en: 🪞 You polish the old mirror… and a second penguin steps out! Your twin wants to help.
intro.zh: 🪞 你擦了擦旧镜子… 镜子里走出另一只企鹅！你的分身要来帮忙。

q.en: You each make {x} cupcakes a minute for {t} minutes. How many together?
q.zh: 你们每人每分钟做 {x} 个，做 {t} 分钟，一共做几个？

text.en: Double speed! You earn {t} extra coins. The twin leaves a mirror shard.
text.zh: 双倍速度！多赚 {t} 金币。分身留下一块魔镜碎片。

text.en: The twin gets confused and steps back into the mirror.
text.zh: 分身搞糊涂了，又走回镜子里。

intro.en: 💰 While digging a new cellar, the floor gives way — you slide into {place}! A treasure chest!
intro.zh: 💰 挖新地窖时地板塌了，你滑进了{place}！有个宝箱！

q.en: The chest has {r} rows of {c} gold coins. How many coins?
q.zh: 宝箱里金币摆成 {r} 排，每排 {c} 枚，一共多少枚？

q.en: You share them equally with the mole who found it first. How many do you get?
q.zh: 和最先发现的鼹鼠平分，你得几枚？

text.en: You climb out with {half} coins and a treasure map!
text.zh: 你带着 {half} 金币和一张藏宝图爬了出来！

text.en: The mole grabs the chest and digs away!
text.zh: 鼹鼠抱起宝箱挖洞跑了！

intro.en: ❄️ Snow blocks the road — the strawberry van is stuck in {place}! Take the sledge.
intro.zh: ❄️ 大雪封路，草莓车被困在{place}！坐雪橇去拉货。

q.en: You need {need} strawberries. The sledge carries {k} each trip. How many trips?
q.zh: 要运 {need} 颗草莓，雪橇每趟能拉 {k} 颗，要跑几趟？

text.en: All delivered! The driver gives you {k} extra strawberries.
text.zh: 全部运到！司机多送你 {k} 颗草莓。

text.en: Too cold — you bring back only {n} strawberries.
text.zh: 太冷了，只拉回 {n} 颗草莓。

intro.en: ⏰ The kitchen clock has stopped! You must time the oven yourself.
intro.zh: ⏰ 厨房的钟停了！只能自己算烤箱的时间。

q.en: You bake {t} trays, one after another, {m} minutes each. How many minutes in total?
q.zh: 烤 {t} 盘，一盘接一盘，每盘 {m} 分钟，一共几分钟？

text.en: Perfect timing — the cupcakes are golden. +{t} coins.
text.zh: 时间刚好，蛋糕烤得金黄。+{t} 金币。

text.en: One tray burns a little.
text.zh: 有一盘有点烤焦了。

intro.en: 🍭 A rainbow slide opens behind the fridge — WHEEE! You land in {place}!
intro.zh: 🍭 冰箱后面出现一条彩虹滑梯——呜！你滑进了{place}！

q.en: Gingerbread kids buy {n} cupcakes at {p} {money} each. How many {money}?
q.zh: 姜饼小孩买 {n} 个蛋糕，每个 {p} {money}，一共多少{money}？

q.en: Each of the {r} sugar trees gives you {g} lollipops. How many lollipops?
q.zh: {r} 棵糖果树，每棵送你 {g} 根棒棒糖，一共几根？

text.en: A gingerbread friend comes home with you!
text.zh: 一个姜饼小人跟着你回家了！

text.en: You eat too many sweets and slide home sleepy.
text.zh: 糖吃太多，迷迷糊糊滑回了家。

intro.en: 🦶 THUMP… THUMP… A friendly giant bends down to the door: "One cake, my size please!"
intro.zh: 🦶 咚… 咚… 一位友好的巨人弯腰到门口：“来一个我这么大的蛋糕！”

q.en: A normal cake uses {s} strawberries. The giant's cake is {k} times bigger. How many strawberries?
q.zh: 普通蛋糕用 {s} 颗草莓，巨人的蛋糕大 {k} 倍，要几颗？

text.en: The giant pays {k} coins and gives you a giant spoon!
text.zh: 巨人付了 {k} 金币，还送你一把巨人勺！

text.en: The cake is too small — the giant shrugs and leaves.
text.zh: 蛋糕太小，巨人耸耸肩走了。

intro.en: 👻 At closing time the lights flicker… a little ghost floats in!
intro.zh: 👻 打烊时灯一闪一闪… 一只小幽灵飘了进来！

q.en: You have {s} cupcakes. The ghost gobbles {g}. How many are left?
q.zh: 你有 {s} 个蛋糕，幽灵吃了 {g} 个，还剩几个？

q.en: The ghost pays {k} ghost coins for each one it ate. How many ghost coins?
q.zh: 幽灵每吃一个付 {k} 枚幽灵币，一共付几枚？

text.en: The ghost giggles and leaves a ghost coin as a souvenir.
text.zh: 幽灵咯咯笑着，留下一枚幽灵币做纪念。

text.en: Boo! The ghost vanishes without paying.
text.zh: 呜！幽灵没付钱就消失了。

intro.en: 🎺 A parade marches past the shop — animals in {r} rows of {c}!
intro.zh: 🎺 游行队伍经过小店——动物们排成 {r} 排，每排 {c} 只！

q.en: How many animals are in the parade?
q.zh: 游行队伍里一共有多少只动物？

q.en: Half of them stop for a cupcake. How many cupcakes?
q.zh: 其中一半停下来买蛋糕，要几个蛋糕？

text.en: Busy, busy! +{half} coins.
text.zh: 忙坏了！+{half} 金币。

text.en: The parade moves on before you are ready.
text.zh: 你还没准备好，队伍就走远了。

intro.en: 🤖 BEEP! A robot inspector rolls in to test your sums.
intro.zh: 🤖 嘀！一台机器人检查员滚进来考你算账。

q.en: The robot pays with a 20-coin note for a {p}-coin cake. How much change?
q.zh: 机器人用 20 金币买一个 {p} 金币的蛋糕，找多少零钱？

q.en: It buys {n} more at {p} coins each. How much is that?
q.zh: 它又买了 {n} 个，每个 {p} 金币，一共多少？

text.en: BEEP BOOP — inspection passed! It gives you a shiny bolt.
text.zh: 嘀嘟——检查通过！它送你一颗亮晶晶的螺丝。

text.en: ERROR… the robot rolls away to recalculate.
text.zh: 错误… 机器人滚回去重新计算了。

intro.en: 👹 Not one, but {b} big monsters — and their minions come in {w} waves!
intro.zh: 👹 来了 {b} 只大怪兽，小怪还分 {w} 波冲进来！

q.en: Each wave has {n} minions. How many minions altogether?
q.zh: 每波 {n} 只小怪，一共几只？

q.en: Each big monster has {h} hearts; your cannon takes {d} per shot. How many shots for ALL {b} big monsters?
q.zh: 每只大怪 {h} 颗心，奶油炮每发打 {d} 颗，打倒全部 {b} 只要几发？

text.en: 🎉 Victory! The monsters drop {b} coins each.
text.zh: 🎉 胜利！每只大怪掉 {b} 金币。

text.en: They take {w} strawberries and stomp off.
text.zh: 它们抢了 {w} 颗草莓，咚咚咚走了。
